name: Xorrn
description: Xorrn was a mineral rich planet located in the Ferra sector within the Outer Rim Territories. Xorrn was a young planet. As the surface of the planet had only recently begun to cool, the natural resources of the planet were easily accessed. However the unstable crust and prohibitive start-up costs prevented nearly all mining operations.
